_about: Starship 是否在 2025-03-31 前实际入轨的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-01-31。

evidence.title: Starship flight test 7
evidence.excerpt: Flight 7 lifted off from Orbital Launch Pad 1 (OLP-1) on January 16, 2025, at 22:37:00 UTC.
evidence.claim: 截至日前星舰已完成 Flight 7 发射，但该次仍为亚轨道弹道飞行。

evidence.title: Starship's Seventh Flight Test
evidence.excerpt: The first Starship flight test of 2025 flew with ambitious goals: seeking to repeat our previous success of launching and catching the world's most powerful rocket.
evidence.claim: SpaceX 官方页面记录 Flight 7 已实际执行，未声明进入轨道。
